html:
SMTO-CTX-0035 — The task gave its notes tool a value it can't accept

GUID: e76ec6ca-59cb-598a-a336-667fa9a65ecd
Slug: task-context-input-invalid
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: task-context

What happened

  • While keeping its working notes, the task sent a value the notes tool doesn't accept, such as a name in the wrong form or text that is too long. The task is told which value to correct.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let the task continue and watch its activity for a corrected notes step. The message names the exact value that was wrong, so the task can usually fix it itself.
  2. If the same message keeps appearing, select Steer and ask the task to keep its notes shorter and simpler. Many of these refusals come from note names or text that are too long or in the wrong form.
  3. If the task still repeats it, select Stop current task and start a new task for the remaining work. A new task starts with fresh notes and avoids repeating the same mistake.

What success looks like

  • The task saves or reads its notes and carries on without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't change security or access settings to make the notes tool accept the value.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Task Context notebook operation rejected an argument (for example an invalid key, revision, size, limit, search match or reference); the recorded reason names the exact field.

What this means

  • A notebook argument violates the operation contract. The recorded reason and operation message identify the specific condition.

Why this can happen

  • The notebook producer reports a reviewed invalid key, revision, size, update or reference argument.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the operation, reason, revision and source reference recorded by the producer.

How to fix it

  • Read the reason in the tool result or Technical details (for example invalid_book_key, invalid_note_size, invalid_limit, invalid_revision) and correct that argument against the task_context tool definition before calling again. Keep the existing source access and revision checks, and use the error record's execution fields rather than assuming nothing ran.
  • Correct the indicated argument using the tool schema and the recorded validation message.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the indicated argument or refresh the source first; retain existing access checks and revision checks.

How to verify the fix

  • The corrected notebook operation succeeds.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass source access checks or overwrite a revision conflict.

Technical notes

  • An unavailable source does not prove that no relevant information exists.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
